status: DRAFT - NOT FROZEN. Not a pre-registration. Becomes binding only when renamed to experiments/BRUTE_PLAN_003.json and committed, with owner decisions resolved, BEFORE any v0.1.1 code is written.
freeze_rule: criteria, thresholds, seeds, tau, epsilon, caps and arms are fixed by the commit that adds BRUTE_PLAN_003.json; that commit must precede every commit touching brute/core/fallback.py, brute/api/service_v011.py, experiments/brute_study_003.py or experiments/v011_independent_reference.py (checked by git log order in verify_release_011)

parent_study.files_left_frozen: everything listed in BRUTE_SOURCE_FREEZE_002.json and BRUTE_RELEASE_FREEZE_010.json stays byte-identical

design_data_disclosure: study-002 traces (all seeds 1130001..1190024) and a replay of the frozen v0.1.0 learner on study-001 drift4/ood5 seeds were inspected post hoc to design v0.1.1 (scripts/explore_v011.py, docs/research/v0.1.1/POSTHOC_V011.json). Those seeds are design data and are not used for any v0.1.1 claim.
heldout_note: new blocks, disjoint from study-001 (930001..990024), study-002 (1130001..1190024) and the calibration set

arms.v0.1.1: brute.core.fallback.FallbackBruteLearner (F1 fallback + F3 retraction bookkeeping), tau below
arms.v0.1.0_control: frozen brute.core.learner.BruteLearner with the same tau, run on the same cases
arms.v0.90_control: bgr90 AdequacyLearner expanded certificate and forecast (as in study-002)
arms.v0.89_reference: n<=3 catalogue on its valid steps (paired)
arms.ablation_reported: v0.1.1 with the suffix1 tier disabled (margin->uniform only)

probability_rule: before the declared family is contradicted: identical to v0.1.0, p=(1-eps)*p_v090+eps/4. After contradiction: if the <=5 margin is still supported, p=(1-eps)*uniform(margin_support)+eps/4; else p=(1-eps)*suffix1+eps/4; else uniform. forecast_source is recorded. The fallback never certifies.
certification_rule: identical to BRUTE_PLAN_002.json certification_rule (gate order unchanged)

residual_surprise.tau_rule: carried over unchanged from results/study-002/CALIBRATION.json; NOT refit
residual_surprise.calibration_check: rerun experiments/brute_calibrate-equivalent with v0.1.1 code on the same in-family study-001 calibration seeds (930001..970024 blocks, 5 in-family families, 3 mask rates); tau must reproduce byte-for-byte (gated, part of G7)

G1_in_family_soundness.threshold: conditional false certificates = 0 and public false certificates = 0 on every in_family case, all 44 steps incl. burn-in

G2_ood5_false_certs_zero.threshold: conditional false certificates on ood5 = 0, all steps

G3_drift4_false_certs_zero.threshold: conditional false certificates on drift4 = 0, all steps
G3_drift4_false_certs_zero.pre_registered_risk: Inferred: likely to fail on some seed blocks. On study-001 drift4 seeds the v0.1.0 learner issues 19 certs, 6 wrong, all exactly at drift perturbation steps (12, 23) with margin agreeing and residual < tau; any causal certifier with in-family coverage on those histories issues them. F1 does not change certification, so v0.1.1 has the same exposure. A failure is reported as a failure; no post-hoc relaxation.
G3_drift4_false_certs_zero.owner_decision_before_freeze: RESOLVED 2026-10-24 18:20 EDT: replaced by G3_prime (owner choice)

G3_prime_alternative.gated: only if chosen instead of G3
G3_prime_alternative.threshold: drift4 false certificates at non-perturbation steps (step not in {12,23,34}) = 0 AND total drift4 false certificates <= 0.5 x v0.90 control on the same cases; total drift4 false certs reported with target 0

G4_public_safety.threshold: 0 public certificates on ood5 and drift4; 0 wrong public certificates anywhere

G5_false_alarm_limit.threshold: fraction of in_family cases with >=1 RESIDUAL_SURPRISE alarm <= 0.05; step-level rate reported

threshold.drift4_mean_post_burn_in: <= ln 4 AND <= v0.1.0_control on the same cases (no regression)

reported_targets.drift4_mean: <= suffix1 baseline on the same cases (Simulated on design data: 1.017814 vs 1.166383)
reported_targets.per_mask: ood5 and drift4 each mask rate vs ln 4
reported_targets.paired_bootstrap: v0.1.1 - v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 - uniform, clustered by seed, 2000 resamples, seed 20261024

G7_in_family_no_change.threshold: (a) mean post-burn-in log-loss per in_family family <= v0.90 control + 0.05 nats; (b) on every in_family step before any contradiction, v0.1.1 probabilities, status, reason and certificate are identical (exact equality) to the v0.1.0_control arm; (c) tau reproduces byte-for-byte

G8_retraction_semantics.threshold: every retraction reason equals the evaluator truth: falsified_by_observation iff the cert's own observed bits contradict it; scope_withdrawn iff compatible and fully observed; unverifiable_masked otherwise. Count of falsified_by_observation equals the count of wrong certs whose bits were observed

G9_compute_budget.threshold: peak rows <= 160000 for both learners; every budget exhaustion yields ABSTAIN/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; no budget exhaustion in a case where the v0.1.0_control arm had none
G9_compute_budget.reported: peak rows per family (study-002 peak margin rows 99818), total wall-clock (target <= 2x v0.1.0_control arm)

G10_independent_audit.threshold: experiments/v011_independent_reference.py (new, no import of brute) recomputes every <=4 and <=5 support, every decision, every fallback probability and forecast_source, every residual and alarm, and every retraction reason; 0 mismatches

G11_reproducibility.threshold: a second run to a new path gives byte-identical SCIENTIFIC.json and CALIBRATION check (timing keys stripped)

R1_coverage.report: post-burn-in coverage and selective risk per family and mask for v0.1.1, v0.1.0, v0.90, v0.89; abstention breakdown; in_family coverage expected identical to v0.1.0 (follows from G7b). Coverage target for v0.1.1: no change; recovery is v0.2.0

R2_loss_decomposition.report: ood5 and drift4 loss split into before-contradiction (by status), contradiction step, after contradiction (by forecast_source)

R3_witness_audit_F14.report: scripts/witness_audit.py: n<=5 divergent witness count on CERTIFIED steps (expected 0) and on MARGIN_DISAGREES steps

R4_drift_stress_replay.report: v0.1.1 on the study-001 drift4 seeds (design data): certs, wrong certs, wrong certs at perturbation steps, retraction reasons

R5_out_of_scope_margin.report: after-contradiction steps where forecast_source=margin_n5 and the actual code is outside the margin support (Open risk for >5-state worlds)

R6_v089_paired.report: v0.89 vs v0.1.1 on v0.89-valid steps

scoring.loss: -ln max(1e-12, p[actual]) on the full code

deviation_policy: after freeze, any change is a ledger 'deviation' entry with reason; the original criterion is still reported. Study-003 seeds are never used to tune v0.1.1; a failed gate is published as failed.
independent_audit_rule: the reference implementation is written from this plan text, not from brute/core/fallback.py, and must not import brute
limitations: F1 assumes the world has <=5 states after contradiction; it is a forecast, never a certificate.
Drift-step false certificates are unavoidable for a causal certifier with in-family coverage (see G3 risk).

owner_decisions.D1: owner (James) chose G3_prime instead of G3
owner_decisions.D2: owner approved implementation, study-003 and release
